_comment: Achievements (issue #150, docs/STEAM.md). One list for Steam and the in-game Achievements page. 'id' is the Steam API name: never rename or remove one once it is live on Steam. 'when' is a Journal.meets/Story.meets condition, 'check' a named check in scripts/achievements.gd (with 'min'), 'event' an event the game reports (Achievements.event), 'counter' a lifetime count kept across saves (with 'min'). 'hidden' keeps the name and description secret until unlocked (story spoilers). 'content' is the chapter that makes it reachable; 'later' entries are designed but wait for content that is not in the game yet (they show as locked and never unlock). 'group' orders the in-game page.
